$comment: Source-of-truth catalog for the public ontology registry served from /documentation/ontologies/. Version folders live under public/documentation/ontologies/<family>/<country>/versions/<version>/ and each contains one .ttl file plus a release.json. Run `npm run ontologies:build` after adding or changing a release.

entries.title: FBO – FireBIM Building Ontology (core)
entries.description: The European umbrella ontology. Country-agnostic fire-safety concepts (zones, elements, systems, functions, quantities, fire-safety properties) that the national modules link back to via fbo:isLinkedTo / fbo:hasSubitem.

entries.title: FBO-BE – Belgium
entries.description: Belgian fire-safety vocabulary with legal definitions, regulation references and links to the core FBO concepts and to IFC.

entries.title: FBO-DK – Denmark
entries.description: Danish fire-safety vocabulary (BR18 and guidelines) with Danish and English labels and definitions, regulation references and links to the core FBO concepts and to IFC.

entries.title: FBO-LT – Lithuania
entries.description: Lithuanian fire-safety vocabulary with legal definitions, regulation references and links to the core FBO concepts and to IFC.

entries.title: FBO-NL – Netherlands
entries.description: Dutch fire-safety vocabulary (Bbl) with legal definitions, regulation references and links to the core FBO concepts and to IFC.

entries.title: FBO-PT – Portugal
entries.description: Portuguese fire-safety vocabulary with legal definitions, regulation references and links to the core FBO concepts and to IFC.

entries.title: FBO → IFC 4.3 mapping
entries.description: The official alignment module. Each named individual describes how an FBO term is expressed in IFC 4.3: IFC class and predefined type, property set and property, data type, expected value and whether it is a buildingSMART standard property.

entries.title: IFC 4.3 (OWL rendering used by the FireBIM API)
entries.description: Reference ontology consumed by the FireBIM platform sync hook. Not part of the FBO documentation.

entries.title: RIR (OWL rendering used by the FireBIM API)
entries.description: Reference ontology consumed by the FireBIM platform sync hook. Not part of the FBO documentation.
